verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing names a built-in "AI-powered expense assistant" (brex-docs-16) and AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments (brex-docs-7), so it ships an in-product assistant. The evidence is only thin marketing mentions, though, and says nothing about what users can actually hand off to it. The MCP server (brex-docs-21) serves external assistants, not a built-in one, so it earns no credit here; community criticism of a ChatGPT blog example is not a concrete contradiction of the in-product assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's capabilities and how tasks are handed to it, assistant coverage beyond expenses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
